technical.summary: Bullish momentum with strong oscillator confluence (RSI, MACD, Stoch crosses) and three white soldiers pattern, but weak trend confirmation (low ADX, no SAR flip) and subaverage volume limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 70 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure from junior members combined with market fear sentiment presents a mild contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and absence of senior conviction limits signal strength.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (333), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent FOMC decision create severely adverse macro conditions; 70-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + MACD/Stoch bullish crosses offer technical momentum setup with price near support (226.06) in a fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 333, flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC imminent), zero fundamental catalysts, weak trend confirmation (no ADX/SAR/Hull MA), subaverage volume, and high earnings risk within 70 days overwhelm technical signals.
